solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Divide a city in Croatia

definitions.meaning: to divide is to separate into parts, as in splitting the bill
The port city on Croatia's Dalmatian coast

explanation.surface: An instruction to partition a Croatian city.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb sense is a plain synonym for separating, and the place sense names the Adriatic port.

clue.text: Face team

definitions.meaning: a face of a cube or building is one of its surfaces
a team in sport is a squad of players

explanation.surface: Two words, as if facing up to an opposing team.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat surface of a solid is one of its faces; a sports squad is also called this.

clue.text: Quick speed for lap

definitions.meaning: going at quite a ... means moving fast
to lap is to take up liquid with the tongue, as a cat does

explanation.surface: A runner going at a fast pace on a circuit of the track.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally a brisk pace is a lick; a cat lapping milk is licking it up.

clue.text: Great Dane let loose in open-air restaurant

indicators.note: a dog let loose runs free, so these letters are freed to take a new order

explanation.surface: A big dog off its lead runs amok among outdoor diners.
explanation.definitionFit: An outdoor place serving refreshments, especially tea, is a garden of that kind.

clue.text: Mistake in large bell?

definitions.meaning: a ... is British slang for a blunder, as in dropping one
a big bell makes a clang, so whimsically it is a thing that clangs; the question mark flags the invented sense

explanation.surface: Asking whether an error lies in a big bell.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang for a gaffe; the second reading invents a noun for something that clangs.

clue.text: Inside vehicle, the main ascendant emperor

indicators.note: the inner piece sits inside the vehicle word, between its letters

parts.note: a car is a motor vehicle

indicators.note: in a down clue something ascendant rises, so the word is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: the main is a poetic name for the open sea

explanation.surface: Inside a carriage, a ruler who has risen to command the seas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is the old poetic name for the sea; in this down clue 'ascendant' means it reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Julius and Augustus are the famous Roman bearers of this title of rulers.

clue.text: Every one of great stature lacks leadership

indicators.note: the word loses its leading letter, the one at its head

parts.note: a person of great stature is tall

explanation.surface: Everyone towering over others has no leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lacks leadership' drops the T from TALL.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun means each and every one of a group, the whole lot.

clue.text: An inclination to wither away in allotment

indicators.note: the dying word is set in the middle of the allotment word

parts.note: an allotment or allocation is a grant
to wither away is to die

explanation.surface: A tendency for plants to shrivel on a vegetable plot.
explanation.definitionFit: A slope or incline is measured as a gradient, so the two are synonyms.

clue.text: A boy in the grass, thought logically

indicators.note: the boy sits in the middle of the grass word

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wet ground
a son is a boy

explanation.surface: A lad lying in tall grass, pondering things carefully.
explanation.definitionFit: To reason is to think in an orderly, logical way, so the past forms match.

clue.text: State capital in Delaware joining English and Irish county

indicators.note: the capital letter of a word is its first letter

parts.note: Clare is a county in the west of Ireland

explanation.surface: Naming Delaware's capital and joining England with an Irish county.
explanation.walkthrough: 'State' looks like a US state; it is the verb meaning announce.
explanation.definitionFit: To state something is to declare it, announce it formally.

clue.text: Far-eastern city in Nepal has appeal

indicators.note: the city's name is tucked in the words that follow, spanning them

explanation.surface: An Asian city in Nepal proves attractive to visitors.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Tibet, a city in the high Himalaya of eastern Asia.

clue.text: This setter's material for a liqueur

parts.note: the setter is Mara, so the setter's is Mara's
chino is a twilled cotton cloth

explanation.surface: The setter lending some fabric to make a cherry drink.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet cherry liqueur from Dalmatia, which also names the cocktail cherry.

clue.text: Tom, a chap going round river on a boat

parts.note: a tom is a male cat

indicators.note: the chap word goes round the river letter and what follows it

parts.note: a chap is a man

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece on another sits above it

explanation.surface: A tomcat and a man sail round a river in a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets R above A, giving RA, and 'going round' puts MAN around it to make MARAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A twin-hulled sailing vessel is a kind of boat.

clue.text: Turn over a failure in footwear

parts.note: to flip is to turn over
a flop is a failure

explanation.surface: Tripping up in one's shoes and failing.
explanation.definitionFit: Light rubber thong sandals are named for the slapping sound they make.

clue.text: Menus designed with oil paint

indicators.note: the letters are designed afresh, arranged into a new pattern

explanation.surface: Menus decorated using oil paint.
explanation.definitionFit: A water-based household wall paint is called by this name.

clue.text: Gentle beast beginning to dislike a character from Greece

parts.note: a lamb is proverbially a gentle creature

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A meek animal starting to dislike a Greek person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' looks like a person; it is a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: The eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet, written as an inverted V.

clue.text: Expert pockets a hundred immediately

indicators.note: to pocket something is to take it inside, so the first word holds the second

parts.note: an ace is an expert
a ton is slang for a hundred

explanation.surface: A skilled operator quickly pocketing a hundred pounds.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means right now, without delay.

clue.text: Filthy food, boy discarding nothing

parts.note: grub is slang for food

indicators.note: the boy word throws away the letter that stands for nothing

parts.note: taken as written
O, the round figure, means nothing

explanation.surface: A dirty meal, and a lad who throws nothing away.
explanation.definitionFit: Something grubby is dirty, covered in grime.

clue.text: One such as dad, mum or sis — though not bro!

definitions.text: One such as dad, mum or sis — though not bro!

parts.words: One such as dad, mum or sis — though not bro!
parts.note: dad, mum and sis read the same backwards, but bro does not, so the clue lists words of that symmetric type

explanation.surface: Family members listed with a brother left out.
explanation.definitionFit: A word reading identically in both directions, like level or radar.

clue.text: Call for some jewellery

definitions.meaning: to call someone on the phone is to give them a ...
a band of gold worn on the finger

explanation.surface: Phoning about buying jewels.
explanation.definitionFit: Telephoning is ringing someone; a finger band is a piece of jewellery.

clue.text: By the sound of it, perfume put in the post

indicators.note: the word for perfume, spoken, matches a word with different spelling

parts.note: a scent is a perfume

explanation.surface: Perfume posted off, judging by its smell.
explanation.definitionFit: Something mailed has been dispatched, so the past participle fits.

clue.text: Prone to be telling fibs

definitions.meaning: prone means flat down, stretched out

explanation.surface: Apt to be dishonest.
explanation.definitionFit: Being recumbent and being untruthful share one word, from two different verbs.

clue.text: Set stage up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: a leg is a stage of a journey or race

explanation.surface: Prepare the theatre's stage.
explanation.definitionFit: When jelly sets it firms up, which is what it means to gel.

clue.text: Simple, holding nothing back: that's the mark of music!

indicators.note: the first word holds the second within it

parts.note: bare means plain or simple

indicators.note: back means the word for nothing is read in reverse

parts.note: nil means nothing

explanation.surface: A plain, unrestrained statement that this is real musicianship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' is easy to read with 'holding nothing' as restraint; it is the reversal signal, and 'mark of music' is a line on the stave.
explanation.definitionFit: A vertical line on a stave dividing the measures is a mark in written music.

clue.text: Fine moves aplenty

indicators.note: the letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A financial penalty for making many moves.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine is a monetary punishment, a sanction for an offence.

clue.text: Dark, curious thing

indicators.note: something curious is odd, so these letters are put into an odd new order

explanation.surface: A strange, sinister object.
explanation.definitionFit: After dark means after nightfall, so the noun is a synonym.
